items.exampleEn: I wear jeans on the weekend.
This bag is made of cloth.
Take an umbrella. It is going to rain.
He wears a white shirt to work.
My sister has short black hair.

items.audioEn: It is raining. Don't forget your umbrella!
items.audioZh: 在下雨，別忘了你的雨傘！

items.sentenceEn: Her hair is long and pretty.
I keep my phone in my bag.

items.stemEn: I like to ____ jeans and a white shirt.
items.stemZh: 我喜歡穿牛仔褲和白襯衫。

items.passageEn: Today is Mia's birthday party. She wears a pretty red dress and some gold jewelry. Her hair is long and black. It is raining outside, so her friends come with umbrellas. One friend gives her a small cloth bag as a gift.
items.passageZh: 今天是 Mia 的生日派對。她穿了一件漂亮的紅色洋裝，戴了一些金飾。她的頭髮又長又黑。外面在下雨，所以她的朋友都帶著雨傘來。有一位朋友送她一個小布包當禮物。

items.promptZh: 她穿著一件漂亮的洋裝。
referenceEn: She is wearing a pretty dress.
rubricZh: 「穿著」可用 is wearing 等（寫 wears、is in a pretty dress 也接受）
形容詞 pretty 放在名詞前面（例如 a pretty dress；寫 beautiful 也正確）

items.instructionZh: 用 wear 造一個句子，說說你上班或上學通常穿什麼。
referenceEn: I usually wear jeans to school.
I wear a white shirt to work.
rubricZh: wear 後面直接接衣物（例如 wear jeans）
習慣性的事用現在簡單式
「穿去上班（上學）」可用 to work、to school
